name: tapestry
description: Register Tapestry's MCP servers (memory + docs) with VS Code so they're available to Copilot Chat and other MCP-aware agents.

tapestry.memoryMcpUrl.description: The URL of your Tapestry memory MCP deployment, e.g. https://your-memory-host.example.com/mcp/memory/ . Leave empty to skip registering the memory server.

tapestry.docsMcpCommand.description: The Python interpreter used to launch the docs MCP via `python -m docs_mcp`. Override if `python` doesn't resolve to your tapestry-docs-mcp install on PATH (e.g. `python3` or an absolute path).

tapestry.docsMcpEnabled.description: Whether to register the tapestry-docs stdio MCP server. Requires `pip install tapestry-docs-mcp` first.
